name: Egg Hatch Polish and Pet Power HUD

changes.name: SkyboundHatchPolish
changes.source:
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local map=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap")
local function rarity(name)
 if name:find("Dragon") then return "LEGENDARY" end
 if name:find("Cub") or name:find("Lion") then return "EPIC" end
 if name:find("Fox") then return "UNCOMMON" end
 return "COMMON"
end
for _,prompt in ipairs(map:GetDescendants()) do
 if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and prompt.Name=="HatchPrompt" then
  prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
   local egg=prompt.Parent;if not egg:IsA("BasePart") then return end
   local original=egg.CFrame
   for i=1,3 do
    TweenService:Create(egg,TweenInfo.new(.08),{CFrame=original*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(12))}):Play();task.wait(.08)
    TweenService:Create(egg,TweenInfo.new(.08),{CFrame=original*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-12))}):Play();task.wait(.08)
   end
   egg.CFrame=original
   local gui=Instance.new("BillboardGui");gui.Name="HatchFlash";gui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(250,80);gui.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,5,0);gui.AlwaysOnTop=true;gui.Parent=egg
   local label=Instance.new("TextLabel");label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);label.BackgroundTransparency=1;label.Text="✨ HATCHING... ✨";label.TextScaled=true;label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;label.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);label.TextStrokeTransparency=.1;label.Parent=gui
   task.delay(1,function() if gui.Parent then gui:Destroy() end end)
  end)
 end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
 p.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
  if child.Name=="Pets" then
   child.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
    if not v:IsA("StringValue") then return end
    v:SetAttribute("Rarity",rarity(v.Value))
   end)
  end
 end)
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets")
 if inv then inv.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v) if v:IsA("StringValue") then v:SetAttribute("Rarity",rarity(v.Value)) end end) end
end)

changes.name: SkyboundPetPowerHUD
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players");local p=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui");gui.Name="SkyboundStats";gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.Parent=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local box=Instance.new("TextLabel");box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(190,44);box.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-95,0,18);box.BackgroundTransparency=.2;box.TextScaled=true;box.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;box.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);box.Parent=gui
local function update() box.Text="⚡ PET POWER: "..tostring(p:GetAttribute("PetPower") or 0) end
p:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PetPower"):Connect(update);update()
